decisions.reason: Certified gasketed plate heat exchangers for HVAC sit close to the core offer and serve a steady market, so the firm has little reason to withdraw them after one year.
The marine box cooler line is described as having a major market share in water cooling systems, which makes it a strong product worth keeping.
The marine cooling unit has its own web page and complements the marine cooler line, so it fits the firm's lifecycle offering in marine.
The compact oil cooler line builds on established competence and serves transportation and industrial customers with recurring demand.
Finned tubes are a core component for air coolers, support the firm's own exchanger production, and are presented prominently.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes draw on the firm's R&D strength and support its efficiency promise, so they are worth retaining.
